description: US corporate actions calendar. Return corporate actions of US-listed stocks and ETFs processed in a month, such as dividends, splits, mergers and name changes, one entry per action, optionally for one symbol. For each company's recent and upcoming dividend dates, see /v3/calendar/dividends. → Returns {total_count, range, last_update, data}. Select a processing month with month=YYYY-MM. Optionally pass code, a SIP: code or a US listing's code such as NASDAQ:AAPL, for one symbol's actions, named by that code; codes of other markets return 400 unsupported_for_endpoint. Each row includes code, action_type, and the available dates and terms for that action.

code.description: A SIP code or the code of a US-listed stock or ETF, such as SIP:AAPL, NASDAQ:AAPL or AMEX:SPY. The symbol's own actions are named by this code.

filter.description: (Optional) JSONata expression to return only the fields or rows you need. See https://jsonata.org for syntax.

output_dir.description: Directory for stored response when output_file is not set.

store.description: Store the response locally instead of returning it. Default is none. csv is only supported for get_symbol_series.

name: get_corporate_actions
